label: Classical mechanics

sources.title: David Tong: Classical Dynamics, Newton’s Laws of Motion

summary: Tong introduces classical mechanics through the motion of particles acted on by forces.

label: Newtonian mechanics

sources.title: David Tong: Classical Dynamics, Newton’s Laws of Motion

summary: Tong presents Newtonian mechanics through the second law governing particle motion in inertial frames.

label: Lagrangian mechanics

sources.title: David Tong: Classical Dynamics, The Lagrangian Formalism

summary: In Tong’s particle formulation, the classical trajectory is a stationary point of the action.

label: Hamiltonian mechanics

sources.title: David Tong: Classical Dynamics, The Hamiltonian Formalism

summary: Tong describes Hamiltonian mechanics using generalized coordinates and momenta in first-order equations of motion.

label: Phase space

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, Classical Gases

summary: Tong describes classical phase space using the positions and momenta of all the particles to specify a system’s state.

label: Statistical mechanics

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, The Fundamentals of Statistical Mechanics

summary: Tong describes statistical mechanics as connecting microscopic physical laws with a description of macroscopic behavior.

label: Thermodynamic entropy

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, Classical Thermodynamics

summary: Tong introduces thermodynamic entropy as a function of the equilibrium state of a system.

label: First law of thermodynamics

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, Classical Thermodynamics

summary: Tong presents the first law of thermodynamics as conservation of energy.

label: Second law of thermodynamics

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, Classical Thermodynamics

summary: Tong states the thermodynamic second-law consequence that the entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

label: Boltzmann distribution

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, The Fundamentals of Statistical Mechanics

summary: In Tong’s canonical-ensemble account, the Boltzmann distribution exponentially suppresses occupation of high-energy states.

label: Partition function

sources.title: David Tong: Statistical Physics, The Fundamentals of Statistical Mechanics

summary: Tong introduces the canonical partition function as the normalization factor for Boltzmann state probabilities.
